request:
Investigate whether Mel’s Rebuttal barrier handles damage correctly when a hit exceeds its remaining strength.

The barrier should absorb damage up to its remaining amount. Any excess should reduce Mel’s health according to the existing damage and resistance rules. Neither damage nor absorption should happen twice, and the barrier should never become negative.

Create tests for hits below, exactly equal to, and above the remaining barrier amount. Include a second hit after the barrier is depleted. Use actual gameplay execution, report what you observe, and repair the code only if you reproduce incorrect behavior.
analysis: The inspected damage path applies resistance before consuming the barrier and subtracts only the remainder from health. No execution result yet establishes incorrect behavior. This scenario uses actual Rebuttal casts and arena damage calls to check below, equal, and above barrier strength, subsequent hits after depletion, and unshielded resistance controls.

scenario.title: Rebuttal barrier absorption and overflow
scenario.expectedBehavior: At zero AP Rebuttal grants 180 barrier. Physical damage uses 60 armor and magic damage uses 40 MR. Each hit consumes at most the remaining barrier, health loses only mitigated overflow once, and depleted barriers remain zero on subsequent hits.
